trusted_assumptions: The Rust 1.96 core::intrinsics::simd::simd_div contract exposes the compiler's elementwise SIMD division result through simd_div_ensures.
axiom_scalar_simd_div_is_f32_div: one-lane f32 SIMD division has the same permitted result relation as primitive scalar f32 division, including target-dependent NaN behavior.
rationale: The div_impl_float! macro expands to self / other. Since scalar / is circular in Verus, the proof faithfully lowers the single operation to the compiler's one-lane SIMD division primitive and uses an explicit target-semantics bridge.
